description: Golden dataset for memory recall evaluation. Each case represents a query with expected memory IDs and distractors.

schema.expected: array of memory IDs that should be in top results
schema.distractors: array of memory IDs that should NOT be in top 5 (semantically close but wrong)
schema.minRecallAt5: 0.85 = at least 85% of expected must appear in top 5

cases.query: what does Marco like to eat
when did I last meet Anna
what did I decide about hiring the head of sales

_note: Add 195 more cases to reach the 200-case minimum. Cases should cover: (1) literal name match, (2) semantic match with no name, (3) graph expansion via entity, (4) type filtering, (5) time window filtering, (6) confidence filtering, (7) multi-hop via relationships, (8) ambiguous resolution, (9) negative cases (no match expected), (10) very recent vs very old.
